create_add_data_dir: add a new data directory to the registered TFDS data dirs for dataset look-up
build_list_data_dirs: list all registered TFDS data directories including the default one
build_list_datasets_in_data_dir: list all dataset references found in a TFDS data directory with optional configs and versions
build_list_dataset_variants: list all config and version variants of a specific dataset in its directory
run_expand_glob: expand a glob path pattern and return all matching file paths
